inclusions.source: Guided visit to the sections open the day of your visit — typically the basilica exterior and courtyards, the Burning Bush (in its enclosed courtyard), and whichever of the icon collection, bone-house, and library exterior are accessible.

inclusions.source: Arrival at your hotel between 13:00 and 15:00 depending on departure time from the monastery.
